name: MagicGUI_RFT
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. MagicGUI-RFT is Honor's Qwen2-VL-7B GUI agent after the second of its two training stages: continued pre-training (which is the separately-catalogued magicgui-cpt) followed by reinforcement fine-tuning, aimed at on-device mobile GUI operation in Chinese and English. Same 8.29B parameters and identical tensor set as the base; the gain is behavioural, not architectural. The card prints Qwen2-VL-7B as a ROW (not a column) in the same HTML tables, so every row below is a same-table comparison. Wins are enormous and consistent - Routine SR 28.1 -> 97.5 - which is what you expect when the base has never seen the authors' action space. Read the source: Magic-RICH is the authors' own in-domain benchmark (Honor, technical report arXiv 2508.03700), so the Magic-RICH rows measure fit to their task formulation; the Referring/AndroidControl/GUI-Odyssey tables are the generalisation evidence. Note the platform drift - Qwen2.5-VL-7B outscores Qwen2-VL-7B on Magic-RICH Routine (76.3 vs 28.1) but MagicGUI's 97.5 still clears it, which is the more honest comparator than the declared base. Apache-2.0, repo created 2025-07-20. Confidence 0.5.
